Class UserBuilder

java.lang.Object
com.ex.tennistournament.builder.UserBuilder
All Implemented Interfaces:
Builder<User>
public class UserBuilder extends Object implements Builder<User>
UserBuilder is a concrete builder for creating User objects. It implements the Builder interface and provides methods for setting User attributes.
